title: 1,380 liters of diesel seized, 1 arrested in Occidental Mindoro
summary: A call from a concerned citizen led to the seizure of approximately 1,380 liters of diesel fuel worth P129,720 and the arrest of an individual in San Jose, Occidental Mindoro on October 6.
